purpose: Paged terrain source for the maximum world-map zoom level

provenance.title: WoW Classic High-res Terrain Maps of Azeroth
provenance.author: teebling / Barrens Chat
provenance.permission: Author permits non-commercial use with attribution and a link to Barrens Chat; see source page.
provenance.classicVisualCheck: PASS: the source has pre-harbor Stormwind; the different ZIP-bundled composite with Stormwind Harbor is excluded

pipeline.edgePolicy: Opaque black padding outside the logical source dimensions
pipeline.runtimePolicy: Bind only pages intersecting the visible max-zoom window; do not preload an atlas

calibration.model: atlasX = 8192 - 0.48 * worldY - ox; atlasY = 8192 - 0.48 * worldX - oy (worldX north, worldY west; 0.48 px per yard = 256 px per ADT tile)
calibration.zoneRects: Vanilla WorldMapArea.dbc bounds, read from pfQuest toolbox/client-data.sql table WorldMapArea_vanilla (reference data, not runtime evidence)
calibration.method: Scale confirmed by a constant 8/16 px chunk-seam phase across each continent. Offsets by maximizing the correlation of water masks (terrain: blue hue; native 1002x668 zone maps from the 1.12 MPQ export: low saturation) over the coastal zones, then snapped to the seam grid. Strong zones agree within 4 px: Hilsbrad, Wetlands, Stranglethorn, Arathi, Hinterlands (EK); Dustwallow, Tanaris, Desolace, Winterspring (Kalimdor). Overlays of Elwynn, Tirisfal, Durotar, Barrens and Teldrassil checked visually.
calibration.uncertainty: About 4 atlas px (8 yards); NOT_TESTED in game

runtimeBudget.estimatedActiveBytes: 12 x 512x512 DXT5 with mips, about 4 MB
runtimeBudget.boundWhile: Last zoom step of a zone map only; cleared when the fade ends, on map change and on map close
